items.name: Bunko · 文庫
items.kind: iPhone · iPad · Android · Mac · Apple Watch
items.description: Read classics with furigana, pinyin and line-by-line translations. Download books and optional dictionary packs for offline reading, then select a word to look it up. Send an excerpt from iPhone to Apple Watch with ruby readings and sentence-by-sentence translations; text and ruby sizes adjust separately.

items.name: LazyOracle
items.description: Explore tarot, the I Ching, and BaZi through reproducible rule-based calculations and optional AI narration. A space for cultural exploration and reflection.

items.name: WeStory
items.description: Join a shared story room, read together and bring an idea to the conversation. An AI editor helps develop the fiction. For adults; a reader account and room invitation are required. Contributing and creating rooms need separate permission.

items.name: LazyingArt Coin
items.description: Look up LAC balances by public Ethereum address and explore the LazyingArt community. A browser companion for LAC and the connected apps.

items.name: L & N speech practice
items.kind: iPhone · iPad · Android · Mac · Apple Watch
items.description: Practice the L/N contrast in English, Mandarin, and Cantonese: listen to word pairs, record a word, and inspect the feedback.

items.name: EchoMind
items.description: Keep text and voice conversations beside optional language support. Full EchoMind access remains invitation-based; central account signup alone does not grant it. Check access before buying.

items.name: AiMemo
items.description: Capture a thought by voice or text, then find and edit the saved memo. Keep notes, tasks and dated entries together. Account required; AI processing is optional.

items.name: OnlyIdeas
items.kind: iPhone · iPad · Mac · Android · web reading room
items.description: Read research with equations, figures and original/translated passages together. Available on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android; try a public paper before importing your own.

items.name: LinguaLeaf
items.description: Read Chinese classics and history with multilingual annotations. Browse the available editions and their source notes.

items.name: LazyLearn
items.description: A growing collection of books, notes, and learning paths for unrushed study.

items.name: Leonard Susskind study archive
items.description: Find transcripts, subtitles, notes, TeX, and PDFs to revisit The Theoretical Minimum lectures.

items.name: LazyTravel · Hakone
items.description: Read a multilingual Hakone guide with aligned Chinese, Japanese, and English material.

items.name: LazyTravel · Xi’an
items.description: Explore Xi’an through a multilingual guide and its companion pocket-book project.

items.name: LazyTravel · Lanzhou
items.description: Read a multilingual Lanzhou guide with its companion pocket-book edition.

items.name: Kindle Book Sender
items.description: Explore a document-transfer workflow for compatible KOReader Kindles. Check device and firmware requirements before installation.

items.name: LazyEarn
items.description: Study money, markets, and entrepreneurship through books and source-linked notes—not earnings forecasts.

items.name: HowYouGotRich
items.description: Read and compare accounts of business, work, and wealth creation. Examples are material to study, not a promised outcome.

items.name: Local Knowledge Terminal
items.description: Find out whether a document collection is ready for local search, multilingual knowledge cards, citations, and provenance.

items.name: AgInTiFlow
items.description: Inspect plans, tool calls, and resumable work from a terminal-first agent workflow.

items.name: AAPS
items.description: Explore structured, inspectable programs and workflows for agent-assisted work.

items.name: LazyRemote
items.description: Learn how the LazyTunnel project connects computers and services through a controlled relay.

items.name: PaperAgent
items.description: Explore reproducible manuscript builds, revision workflows, and source-linked research work.

items.name: Paper revision skill
items.description: Plan and track manuscript revisions, response letters, and reproducible document builds.

items.name: LazySkills
items.description: Browse reusable agent workflows with instructions and supporting tools.

items.name: Astrill lazy policies
items.description: Inspect a documented policy configuration workflow and its source before using it.

items.name: MCP boundary review
items.description: Review one pinned MCP server's authority and data boundaries. Start with the executed sample before a fit check.

items.name: Fun Lazying Art / Musia
items.description: Explore songs with lyrics, timing, and music-practice views.

items.name: Musia: Learn Music & Guitar
items.description: Loop a phrase and slow it down without changing pitch. Follow multilingual lyrics with Chinese pinyin or Japanese furigana, practise guitar chords, or train your ear with Do Re Mi listening quizzes and a 40–160 BPM metronome. Practice history stays on your device. Android 0.1.2 is available; iPhone and Mac editions are awaiting review.

items.name: LazyEdit Studio
items.description: Upload a video, correct multilingual subtitles, adjust the layout and logo, and preview the result in your private Studio. An invitation and internet connection are required. Social publishing is a separate operator-enabled integration.

items.name: WeSticker
items.description: A personal sticker studio for keeping one character consistent across everyday expressions. Explore the local prototype for character references, editable captions and sticker exports. Not yet a public service or an App Store / Google Play release.

items.name: Video work
items.description: Watch selected video work and explore the tools used to assemble it.

items.name: LalaMedias
items.description: Explore the public media project and its source.

items.name: LazyingArt handmade collection
items.description: Browse handmade objects and notebooks. Check the current options and delivery terms on the product page.

items.name: LazyingArt blog
items.description: Practical build stories and guides across language, code, research, and creative tools.

items.name: LazyingArt Games
items.description: Watch the public Weiqi replay without signing in. Interactive learning and the wider game catalogue require an account.

items.name: SHI: The Shape of Power
items.description: Lead a column through late Qin China in a branching historical strategy narrative. Weigh grain, trust and exposure before each order. One purchase, offline play.

items.name: LightMind Agent
items.description: Keep audio notes, reminders and memory cues on your phone; connect compatible smart glasses for supported media workflows. Made by LightMind Tech Limited. Hardware features depend on the device.

items.name: IDEAS research notebook
items.description: Browse ideas and linked research in imaging, photonics, simulation, and related fields.

items.name: OpenHI
items.description: Explore an event-based hyperspectral imaging project and its reproducible research code. Hardware availability is separate.

items.name: IdeasGlass
items.description: Explore a wearable capture project, its firmware, and software design. This is a technical project overview.

items.name: IdeasRobot
items.description: Explore microphone-array sensing, waveform views, and a web-console design. Hardware and deployment are project-specific.

items.name: AgInTi
items.description: Explore the public agent and robotics project and its source.

items.name: LazyingArtBot LAB
items.description: Read about local-first assistant and research orchestration tools. The directory links the overview, not an operator console.

items.name: LifeReverseEngineering
items.description: Explore a source-linked workflow for reading plans and research directions.

items.name: LazyingArt
items.description: The home of LazyingArt's apps, books, tools, and bounded services.

items.name: Lachlan Chen
items.description: Meet the builder and browse public projects and publications.

items.name: The Art of Lazying
items.description: Notes and practical tools for reducing friction in everyday creative and technical work.

items.name: ClearPair H & F
items.description: Hear and practise easily confused H/F sounds in English and Mandarin.

items.name: ClearPair L & R
items.description: Hear and practise easily confused English L/R sounds, from words to sentences.

items.name: ClearPair English
items.description: Practise easily confused English vowels, TH sounds and final consonants.

items.name: ClearPair Mandarin
items.description: Practise Mandarin sounds that are easy to confuse: initials, finals and tones.

items.name: ClearPair Cantonese
items.description: Explore Cantonese tones and confusing sounds with Jyutping and pair practice.

items.name: ClearPair Korean
items.description: Explore easily confused Hangul letters and Korean sound contrasts.

items.name: ClearPair Arabic Letters
items.description: Tell confusing Arabic letters apart through dots, joins and sound families.

items.name: ClearPair Japanese
items.description: Remember confusing kana and practise Japanese vowel length and consonant holds.
